user.title: Step 1 of 4 – Trafikverket API account
user.description:
This integration uses Trafikverket's open API. You need a free API key:

1. Go to {portal} and click **Log in / Register** (Trafiklab account).
2. Confirm your e-mail address and log in.
3. Create a new key under **My keys** and paste it here.

The key is checked against Trafikverket right away.

settings.title: Step 4 of 4 – Data amount and updates
settings.description: Limit how often and how much data is fetched. Everything can be changed later under Configure.

data.enable_weather: Fetch weather from road weather stations
data.minimal_fields: Only fetch the fields that are used

data_description.scan_interval_min: How often data is fetched. 5–15 minutes is usually enough.
data_description.weather_radius_km: The nearest station is used as local weather.
data_description.max_objects: Upper limit of records per data type and fetch.
data_description.max_age_min: Sites that have not reported for this long are hidden.
data_description.minimal_fields: Greatly reduces the amount of data. Turn off only if the API complains.

reauth_confirm.description: The API key no longer works. Create a new one at {portal}.
